function_specs.name: CriticalAreaLock
function_specs.meaning: Existing IRQ boundary transfers one observed global invariant into the critical section.

function_specs.name: CriticalAreaUnLock
function_specs.meaning: Returns the held invariant to the existing outside-critical protocol after a permitted state change.

function_specs.name: KSemaphoreObtain
function_specs.meaning: Existing reviewed OC contract executes the obtain program with the original ID and timeout; body proof remains separate.

function_specs.name: KSemaphoreAbandon
function_specs.meaning: Existing reviewed OC contract executes abandon; this caller intentionally ignores its return code.

function_specs.name: PopDataqueue
function_specs.meaning: Frozen repaired-copy spec: obtain failure returns -1 with unchanged output cells; obtain success returns0 with either empty unchanged output or one dequeued head element.
